div.p: Designs that want to leverage Verilog must use the scripted Lua flow. The orange to blue path describes all the steps necessary.
Each block and ellipse can be manipulated in your script.

div.p: Designs that want to omit the scripting in favour of a more interactive tool can use the web GUI.
If using a native installation, then Lua scripting and Verilog can be used (not currently supported).
